description: A string with two labelled blanks that you fill in each turn. It shows that an agent's memory is prompt-building: you rebuild the prompt and paste the prior context back in.

steps.description: This is a prompt template: a string with labelled `{}` blanks that you fill in each turn. The page calls this the clearest way to see that memory is string-building.
The first line sets the assistant's role: a concise study-planning assistant.
`Conversation so far:` labels the `{history}` blank. This is where prior turns get pasted, so the model sees the context you rebuild on every call.
`{question}` is the user's new message, and `Answer:` cues the model to respond. The model sees only whatever ends up inside the filled-in string.

steps.answer: a stranger meeting you for the first time
steps.question: The page says that if {history} is blank, the model is what, no matter how many times you have talked before?

title: A Prompt Template with Blanks
